description: This collection stores individual question responses from intervention assessments

_id.description: MongoDB unique identifier for the response record

studentId.description: The ID number of the student who answered the question

interventionAssessmentId.description: Reference to the intervention assessment document ID

revisionNumber.description: The attempt/revision number for this intervention (1, 2, 3, etc.)

questionId.description: Unique identifier for the intervention question (prefixed with 'int_')

category.description: The assessment category this question belongs to

questionType.description: Type of question (optional field, added in newer versions)

response.description: The student's response - format varies by category

formats.phonological_awareness: Array of objects with audio-match pairs

isCorrect.description: Whether the student's response was correct

responseTime.description: Time taken to answer the question in seconds

answeredAt.description: Timestamp when the question was answered

readingLevel.description: The student's reading level at time of assessment

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the record was created in the database

correctMatches.description: Number of correct audio-letter matches made

totalMatches.description: Total number of matches required for the question

correctSequence.description: Number of letters placed in correct sequence

totalSequence.description: Total number of letters in the sequence

key_features: Each response is saved individually per question
Question IDs are prefixed with 'int_' to identify intervention questions
Response format varies by assessment category
Includes timing data for performance analysis
Links to specific intervention assessment via interventionAssessmentId
